items.title: Magnum was born as 'Empat Nombor Ekor' — literally 'Four Numbers Tail'
items.detail: Magnum Corporation was incorporated 19 Dec 1968 as Empat Nombor Ekor Sdn Bhd, and on 1 April 1969 became the first private company licensed to run 4D in Malaysia. Pioneer of the game you play today.

items.title: Singapore's first computerized 4D draw (31 May 1986) produced 1st prize 8838
items.detail: 8 sounds like 發 (fā, 'prosper') in Mandarin. The machines picked the luckiest possible number on day one. Turnover jumped 215% that year to S$283 million.

items.title: Sports Toto was started by the Malaysian government in 1969
items.detail: Its original mission: raise funds for sports, youth and cultural activities. It was later acquired by Vincent Tan's Berjaya group.

items.title: 4D began with a schoolboy raffling his bicycle
items.detail: A schoolboy sold 100 $1 tickets, each bearing two digits; the winner matched the last two digits of a Turf Club sweepstake ticket. That became 2D → 3D → 4D, wildly popular since the 1950s.

items.title: Big RM1 1st prize pays RM2,500 — Small pays RM3,500
items.detail: Big wins on any of 23 numbers (top 3 + 10 Special at RM180 + 10 Consolation at RM60). Small only wins on the top 3 — but pays more.

items.title: Your number 1234 is secretly 24 tickets
items.detail: An i-Perm / iBOX / mBOX bet of RM1 on 1234 covers all 24 permutations. One pair (e.g. 1123)? 12 permutations. This is why perm players win small amounts constantly.

items.title: Magnum Life pays RM1,000 EVERY DAY for 20 years
items.detail: That's over RM7.3 million drip-fed daily. The 2nd prize? RM1,000 every day for 100 days.

items.title: Magnum's 4D Jackpot (2009) was the world's first 4D-with-jackpot game
items.detail: Launched 23 September 2009 — pick two 4D numbers (RM2) and chase a pooled jackpot on top of the classic game.

items.title: Unclaimed prizes expire after 180 days
items.detail: Six months to claim, then the money stays with the operator. Check your old tickets. Check them NOW.

items.title: Grand Dragon's draw number IS the date
items.detail: DN 260925 = 26-09-25. It draws every single day, which is why its archives are the hardest to find — and why our GD history starts now.

items.title: Toto tickets carry your Chinese zodiac (生肖)
items.detail: Every SportsToto 4D draw publishes a zodiac for the 1st prize number. Punters cross-reference the zodiac with dreams, temples and the 4D dictionary.

items.title: Singapore Turf Club ran the first Singapore 4D in May 1966
items.detail: First prize: S$2,000 for a $1 ticket. Singapore Pools took over all draws in May 2004.
